task_definition.task_description: Please scan the smart devices in the living room, then lock the main lock and turn the living room light on to full brightness. After that, get the current UTC time, save it in a note titled "Security Lockdown Log," and then back up the security logs workspace.

user_input.query: Please scan the smart devices in the living_room, then lock the main lock using lock_device_id lock_main and turn on the living room light with light_device_id light_living to 100 brightness. After that, get the current time in UTC, save it in a note titled "Security Lockdown Log," and then back up the security logs workspace at /workspace/security_logs.
user_input.title: Security Lockdown Log
